close_reason: Structural constraint: per-item errors require individual calls per mailbox.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set destroy: when onDestroyRemoveEmails=true, each email in the mailbox triggers one destroy_object or update_object call. Plus a query_objects + get_objects pair per mailbox. For a mailbox with N emails, this is N+2 backend roundtrips per destroyed mailbox. The code already has a comment noting this and suggesting batch_destroy_objects. The issue is filed as a tracked gap. For large mailboxes (Inbox with 100K messages), this would be catastrophically slow. The fix requires adding batch operations to MailBackend, which is a breaking API change — must happen before 1.0.
title: Mailbox destroy cascade is O(n) individual backend calls per mailbox
